The main takeaway from our work is that
it is important for researchers to be aware of the limitations of their data acquisition methods, and to account for these limitations in their data analysis.
the functional sensitivity of rapidly sampled fMRI data is not limited by the number of acquired samples, but by the ability to accurately model the temporal correlations.
it is important to account for temporal correlations in fMRI time series when estimating model parameters and assessing the functional sensitivity of competing acquisition schemes.
